title: New Apartments in Bucharest Sector 3: What Is Being Built
description: New apartments for sale in Bucharest Sector 3 in 2026: developments under construction, prices, and what to check before buying. A real buyer guide.
descriptionLlm: A 2026 guide to new apartments in Bucharest Sector 3: active developments, prices, handover dates, and key buying factors. Real examples from Titan-Dristor and Pallady with verified timelines and features.
keywords: new apartments bucharest sector 3, new apartments sector 3, new building sector 3, residential developments sector 3, apartments for sale sector 3
lead: Scaffolding is popping up all across Sector 3. From Titan to Pallady, from Dudești to Mântuleasa, virtually every other construction fence hides a new residential building with units for sale. There are plenty of options, but figuring out which one is a solid investment and which is merely a pretty 3D rendering is not always easy. A 274-unit complex might sound great until you learn the handover is not until 2028. Another 33-unit building may seem boutique, but it has 12 available homes ready in December 2026. What truly matters is what you actually get and when. We reviewed the entire market, and here is what we found.

x: There are at least four key new developments to watch in 2026, with prices starting at around 85,000 euros for a studio and reaching over 337,000 euros for four rooms, all excluding VAT.

VAT on new homes is 21% as of August 2026, with one temporary exception: the 9% rate remains valid until September 30, 2026 for properties up to 120 square meters and up to 600,000 lei, but only if you signed the pre-sale agreement before August 1, 2025.

The most important aspect of a new building is not just the listing price, but what is included and when it is delivered. A 107,500-euro apartment with underfloor heating, triple-glazed windows, and an included individual boiler costs less in the end than an empty 95,000-euro shell.

sections.h2: New Residential Developments in Sector 3 Right Now

blocks.x: These areas are attracting developers from every direction. Not all projects are created equal, and not all of them deserve your attention. Here is what we found on the market right now.

Centropolitan by Cordia is the largest new development in the central area. It features 274 units on Calea Dudești, one minute from București Mall. The investment by Cordia România (part of Hungary's Futureal Group) amounts to 65 million euros. Prices start at around 170,000 euros plus VAT for a 42-square-meter studio and reach 337,000 euros plus VAT for a four-room apartment. Estimated completion: around the fourth quarter of 2028. Construction began in January 2026, and over 12% of units were reserved during pre-sales, totaling more than 8 million euros in transactions. Around 80% of buyers are end-users rather than investors.

Estoria City is located in the Pallady area, on Victor Brauner Street. It encompasses 275 units across 14 hectares, with phases 1 and 2 already completed and nearly sold out. Phase 3 is under construction and over 86% sold. Studios start from 85,000 euros plus VAT, two-room apartments from 124,000 euros plus VAT, and three-room units from 166,000 euros plus VAT. The average price is around 1,990 euros per square meter. The "city-within-a-city" concept includes workspaces, retail shops, and recreation areas on-site.

Astorium Selenium is a new project by Astorium Construct Investment on Gura Caliței Street, an area where the developer already has several residential projects. It features over 300 units on 1.5 hectares, with an estimated investment of 35 million euros. The company is also preparing a boutique complex of around 40 units, plus two other developments totaling over 700 units, valued at more than 60 million euros.

Mântuleasa by Bog'Art is a 54-unit boutique development on Mântuleasa Street, in the prime ultra-central Icoana area. Two-room units start from 269,000 euros plus VAT, and three-room apartments from 363,000 euros plus VAT. Features include smart home tech, EV chargers, and private terraces. This belongs to a different price tier, but it is located right in our sector.

In addition to these, there is Ilioara Residence in Titan-Dristor, a ground-plus-eight-story building with 33 homes, 12 of which are currently available. Prices start from 107,500 euros excluding VAT for two-room units, complete with underfloor heating, Salamander triple-glazed windows, and an Ariston boiler included. Handover is set for December 2026. Direct from the developer, with zero commission. We know this project intimately, as it is our own development.

sections.h2: How Much Do New Homes Cost Here

blocks.x: Prices vary considerably depending on location, finish quality, and completion timeline. A studio in Pallady starts at 85,000 euros plus VAT. A two-room apartment in Titan starts from 107,500 euros plus VAT. A two-room home in the central Mântuleasa area exceeds 269,000 euros plus VAT. The difference reflects location, materials, and what is included in the base price. We strongly advise against comparing properties solely on list price, as this is an easy mistake to make.

At Ilioara Residence, for instance, the 107,500-euro base price includes underfloor heating throughout the apartment, seven-chamber Salamander triple-glazed windows, and a 24-kilowatt Ariston individual boiler. In other projects, these features are costly upgrades. Always compare like-for-like specifications so you are not comparing apples to oranges.

The true calculation starts with the net price without VAT. Adding 21% VAT gives you the actual purchase sum. On a 107,500-euro apartment, 21% VAT adds roughly 22,575 euros, bringing the total to around 130,075 euros. Next comes parking: about 20,000 euros plus VAT for a standard space, or 25,000 euros plus VAT for a Klaus double system. The reservation deposit is separate, typically 2,000 euros plus VAT. We recommend budgeting for every item before signing any contract.
For a detailed breakdown of all expenses, from VAT and notary fees to interior furnishing, check our guide on the true total costs of buying a new apartment.

sections.h2: VAT Rates on New Apartments in 2026

blocks.x: The standard VAT on residential properties is 21% as of August 2026. While a reduced 9% rate was available for a limited time, strict conditions apply. In short: do not count on the reduced rate unless you already signed a pre-sale contract.

Law No. 161/2026, published in the Official Gazette on August 4, 2026, extends the 9% rate through September 30, 2026, but exclusively for homes under 120 usable square meters and priced below 600,000 lei before VAT. Crucially, the pre-sale agreement had to be signed before August 1, 2025. Without a contract signed before that date, standard VAT applies regardless of property size.
After September 30, 2026, all transactions will be subject to 21% VAT, with the sole exception of the Noua Casă program, which operates under its own guarantee framework.

The Noua Casă program remains active in 2026 with a 500 million lei budget ceiling. Minimum down payments are 5% for homes up to 70,000 euros and 15% for properties between 70,001 and 140,000 euros. However, the program requires the building to be fully completed and registered in the land book. Apartments currently under construction, such as Ilioara Residence, will qualify only after final completion and registration.
You can find all the details on financing an off-plan property in our comprehensive guide on mortgages for new construction apartments.

sections.h2: What to Look for When Buying a New Home

blocks.x: Five factors matter far more than just the listing price.

What is included in the price. Underfloor heating, window carpentry, boiler, flooring, and interior doors. If these are not included, budget an extra 10,000 to 20,000 euros. Always get the specifications in writing rather than relying on verbal promises.

The handover date. A project with handover in 2028 means waiting two years, during which tax policies can shift. A development delivering in December 2026, such as Ilioara Residence, means moving in within months. Delivery timelines carry significant financial weight.

Sales progress. A development that is over 86% sold, like Estoria City Phase 3, demonstrates strong market validation. A project with only 12% sold in pre-sales, like Centropolitan, carries more delivery risk, though it may offer launch pricing.

The developer. Check their track record, past projects, and history of on-time delivery. Cordia has extensive experience across Poland and Spain. Astorium has completed several projects in Sector 3. Bog'Art is a major name in construction. Each brings a different profile.

Floor layout and neighbors. Having only four apartments per floor, as in Ilioara Residence, translates to less foot traffic, greater peace and quiet, and fewer homeowner association issues. It is a daily quality-of-life benefit rather than a minor detail.

sections.h2: Why Developers Are Flocking to Sector 3

blocks.x: The advantage is straightforward: available land at lower acquisition costs than central areas, coupled with strong metro access and infrastructure. The Pallady area has transformed completely over the past five years, with new overpasses, widened boulevards, and retail centers. Property prices have risen by roughly 40% to 60% compared to 2020, delivering solid returns to early buyers.

In the Titan-Dristor area, home to Ilioara Residence, direct metro access is matched by quick proximity to Mega Mall and Mall Vitan. Further north, the Mântuleasa-Icoana district remains highly sought after for its historic architecture and distinct urban charm.

Informateca.ro reported in June 2026 that "the number of new developments remains limited compared to other sectors of the capital." This means supply is struggling to keep up with steady demand, which supports property values over the medium term.

faq.q: How much does a new two-room apartment cost in Sector 3?
faq.a: Prices range from around 107,500 euros excluding VAT in Titan-Dristor to over 124,000 euros excluding VAT in the Pallady area and more than 269,000 euros excluding VAT in central neighborhoods. The price gap reflects location, finish specifications, and standard inclusions. Always compare like-for-like features.

faq.q: Can you still get a 9% VAT rate on a new apartment?
faq.a: Only until September 30, 2026, and exclusively if you signed a pre-sale contract before August 1, 2025 for a property under 120 square meters priced at 600,000 lei or less before VAT. Otherwise, the standard 21% VAT rate applies. Full details are set out in Law No. 161/2026.

faq.q: What is the difference between a new and an older building in Sector 3?
faq.a: An older building might seem cheaper at first glance, but it often brings renovation expenses, outdated plumbing and wiring, and significant heat loss. A new build costs more upfront, but it provides modern thermal insulation, brand-new utility networks, and an individual boiler for direct energy management. Over five years, lower utility bills offset a substantial portion of the initial price difference.

faq.q: How many new apartments are available at Ilioara Residence?
faq.a: Out of 33 total apartments, 12 remain available. Most of the remaining units are located on the 6th and 7th floors. The updated availability list is on /apartamente/.
